canon_scenes_turned_away_from.rule: No chapter re-stages a canon scene about a ladder, hatch, cistern, ballcock, coal shed, browse, brush, or telephone ringing. Where a standing object recurs, brush on the passage floor, ladder folded under the front window, box taped on the table, it is stepped over or looked at and not used, in a different scene for a different reason.

cards.0725: A woman of seventy-eight tries a dry ballpoint pen on the gas envelope in her kitchen at number twelve on Sunday the fifteenth of May, puts it back, speaks to her sister at the gate about the lamp, and pulls her front door to for the night.
cards.0726: A man in his early forties sweeps shavings at his unit on Wednesday the eighteenth of May, looks at chalk numbers on paid gates, speaks to a lad about timber, and latches the gate at dark without re-chalking.
cards.0727: A woman in her late forties sorts rags at the lock-up on Sunday the twenty-second of May, rules a new cupboard line and leaves the hall line empty, speaks to the man with keys about the van, and ties the rag bag shut.
cards.0728: A woman in her late fifties takes down and wipes and returns the same bulb at number nine on Saturday the twenty-eighth of May, leaves the jug lid at two layers, speaks to her sister at the gate about the bin, and puts the jug down without a third layer.
cards.0729: A woman in her early thirties tries ply against the shed felt at number ten on Tuesday the thirty-first of May, finds it short, puts the hammer and screwdriver away, speaks to her sister about the paper, and re-pegs the line tighter.
cards.0730: A woman of seventy-eight looks into her front room at number twelve on Friday the third of June, sees the folded ladder and a silent telephone left where it is, speaks to her sister on the step about the room, and comes back to her kitchen.
cards.0731: A man in his early forties drives to the cottage lane on Tuesday the seventh of June, finds the posts true, speaks to the man at the cottage about hands, and drives back without going up the road.
cards.0732: A woman in her late forties clears her van at the lock-up on Friday the tenth of June, leaves the box behind the bench, speaks to a woman who books work about Thursday, and shuts the van doors before driving away.
cards.0733: A woman in her late fifties dusts and sits on the ash stool at number nine on Monday the thirteenth of June, speaks to her sister at the gate about the pads, and switches the front room light off early.
cards.0734: A woman in her early thirties puts tools away and leaves paper out at number ten on Thursday the sixteenth of June, speaks to her sister at the gate about the ninety yards, and walks to the end of her own yard and back.

chapter_files: 540, counted off the files with ls chapters/volume-05/chapter-*.md | wc -l, which is 734 minus 195 plus one. Run at the end of the block and not added up. The figure at the start of the block was 530.
declared_ordinary_word_note: Declared in this file before any chapter of 725 to 734 existed and not after. It is not one of usually, anyway, like, just, enough, still, kind, quite, small, round, one, week, almost, anything, and then, or nearly, all of which are spent. Counted whole word on word boundaries across the ten files after every repair. Measured at 14 across ten, at 1, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 0, 4. Three chapters at nil, two of them 0728 and 0733, and neither was put right. Not nursed in either direction.
dialogue: Required in every chapter. Measured as lines inside quotation marks. Counts are 10, 6, 4, 10, 6, 8, 6, 6, 8, 5 across the ten, and no chapter is at zero. The word said is at 3 across ten because attribution reads says in present tense, which is reported and not put right.
family: This block declares no family. Ten repetitions of one ordinary thing is the defect, whatever the thing is, so each of these ten scenes changes the situation on its own.
figure_that_binds: No spread. Four step ladders on the page and no fifth appeared. The travelling one stays folded under the front window at number twelve with tape on the second rail and chalk on the third. The fixed four rungs by the hatch, the fibreglass one, and the folded one in a back room in a semi are untouched. The two-tread step stool in the unit corner is not a ladder. The brush stays on the passage floor at number twelve and is stepped over and not picked up. The taped box stays taped and the gas envelope stays on the right of the kitchen table at number twelve. The telephone device of the last block is spent as a spread and is used here once only, in 0730, as a silent object left where it is, with no ringing, no call, and no number.
movement: Nothing is rescued. Nothing is resolved by arriving or by acting. The freeholder does not arrive. The line is not put right and no plate is unscrewed and no wire is spliced. The ladder is not opened and no room is painted. No box is opened and no drawer with leads or screws is opened for its contents. The drawer under the worktop at number ten gains two tools in 0729 and holds them in 0734. The hall line on the invoice pad stays empty. The ninety yards stay unwalked, though 0734 walks the yard.

read_back_promise: The prose wins. Each file was opened and read twice against its title, dateline, caps block and roster line, including the order of actions. Figures actually aged were written down by eyes. A second reader was given the ten plus eight canon chapters and the fourteen points from 0053, and the classes to name before prose were an object in two places, a caps block contradicting its body, a date in a card not on the page, a near-verbatim re-stage, a roster adding or omitting a person, a word count without method, a file count by adding up, a band moved inside the block, a secret re-introduced against 0692, a card saying asked where the body asks none, a witness asserted but never staged, an object renamed, and a line about another house the figure could not know. Where prose and card disagreed the file was corrected to the chapter.
